text:
alice: Heads-up - onboarding sampleapp fails when built for Edge with certain bundlers. Vite dev works; Vite build -> Edge deploy crashes. Repro + notes below.

clara: Paste the error?

alice: Edge runtime: 
```
TypeError: Cannot redefine property: exports
 at Object.defineProperty (<anonymous>)
 at Object.<anonymous> (/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js:10:20)
```

alice: Vite prerender during build shows: 
```
Uncaught SyntaxError: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js' does not provide an export named 'createClient'
```

ben: Sounds like consumers are resolving the CJS artifact for ESM imports. We tweaked package.exports recently which may have flipped resolver priority for some bundlers.

dan: Which SDK version?

alice: @redwood/inference-js@2.1.1-canary.2026.03.18. Downgrading to 2.0.5 avoids the defineProperty crash but causes TypeScript errors in our app.

clara: TS failure on CI: 
```
src/client.ts:8:12 - error TS2322: Type 'InferenceClient' is not assignable to type 'ClientFactory'.
8 const client = new InferenceClient(cfg)
```
Because the published .d.ts exports a factory type while runtime exposes a class.

ben: Immediate mitigations: (1) Vite: set `ssr.noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js']` so Vite bundles the ESM output; (2) Webpack/Rollup: alias the package to `@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js`; (3) Explicit import: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'` in Edge handlers.

dan: I reproduced on Rollup + SvelteKit. Rollup resolution picked the CJS path because exports order favored require-style entry.

alice: I uploaded a tiny mono-repo repro: https://gist.github.com/alice/inference-bundler-repro with Vite, Next, and SvelteKit examples and minimal vite.config/rollup.config. Repro steps: npm i, npm run build, npx vercel dev --edge.

ben: Plan: 1) Normalize package.json exports ordering (prefer import/esm for browsers and bundlers), 2) rebuild CJS to avoid defineProperty on module.exports, 3) fix .d.ts to export a class/constructor shape, 4) add CI smoke tests that run `npm pack` + Vite build + vercel dev --edge.

clara: For onboarding docs, I added the Vite ssr.noExternal snippet and an alias example so new users won't be blocked.

ci-bot: CI started for infra-inference#2401: matrix=[vite,rollup,webpack] node=[18,20].

ben: I'll open a patch PR to adjust exports + types and publish a canary; backport to 2.0.x if needed.

alice: Thanks all. Leaving this thread linked to infra-inference#2401. I'll update when canary is published.
